title: Slovakian Woodfired Pork Chops with Indian Spices
description: A fusion dish that combines the rich flavors of Slovakia with the warm spices of India, all in a woodfired twist. This recipe is perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt, black pepper, garam masala, cumin powder, and coriander powder.
In a shallow dish, mix together the yellow mustard seeds and woodfired Slovakian bread crumbs.
Dip each pork chop into the bread crumb mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated pork chops on the preheated woodfired grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
While the pork chops are cooking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pork chops are done cooking, brush them with the melted butter on both sides.
Serve the pork chops hot, garnished with additional bread crumbs and a sprinkle of garam masala if desired.
Repeat the process with the remaining pork chops.
